correctness.rationale: Dirichlet moment differentiation and diagonal digamma shifts give the exact mixed moment. After subtraction, the weighted covariance identity is an algebraic equality. A^2-sum(alpha_i^2)=2 sum_{i<j} alpha_i alpha_j>0 for all m>=2 with alpha_i>0; the digamma function is strictly increasing, making the second term nonnegative. Fraction-based independent mixed-moment checks pass in all 3,900 tested integer vectors; half-integer example is exact. Boundary m=1 is excluded and has zero covariance.

value.rationale: Joint calibration of Shannon and Simpson diversity under nonexchangeable Bayesian Dirichlet priors is a naturally motivated statistical target. The exact all-positive-parameter negativity and digamma covariance decomposition are robust structural information, not a numerical lookup. The exact same-total binary example shows a substantive nonobvious boundary to a symmetry-maximization intuition: covariance magnitude grows by factor 3/2 when concentrations (1,1) become (1/2,3/2). No claim of global optimization or downstream theorem is needed.
